correctness.rationale: For every smooth codimension-ten section of Gr(2,10), the normal sequence gives c(TX)=(1+x)^10(1+y)^10/((1-(x-y)^2)(1+x+y)^10). The exact Schubert integral [x^9 y^8](x-y) H^10 Q evaluates every one of the eleven codimension-six monomials. A fresh standard-library verifier recomputed all eleven with finite rational polynomial arithmetic and also by 45-point equivariant localization. For instance c3=-10xyH leads to c3²=100(C(12,6)-C(12,5))=13200. No finite extrapolation is used: the formulas are valid for every smooth member.

value.rationale: Eleven numbers exhaust the natural degree-six intersection invariants in H and tangent Chern classes for a smooth CY6 closely linked to new Pfaffian geometry. Separate intrinsic c2³=32480, c2c4=26720 and c3²=13200 refine the known topological/Hodge data; six polarized mixed Chern pairings make the result useful for RR and numerical comparison of embeddings. It is a complete natural invariant, not an arbitrary numerical slice. There is no claim of a paper-sized classification.
